Plugin.Name: NBD Export
Plugin.Overview: Host disks over NBD, pull remote nbd:// targets, or convert a local /dev disk or file to qcow2/raw under /mnt. Settings → Network Services → NBD. Read-only Host by default; prefer private bind. Status lists plugin and external qemu-img jobs. Security: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ibigsnet/NBDExport/main/SECURITY.md
